source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 90-125), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Computational Structures) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are computational structures? Name the five primitive computational structures of this chapter.
(Computational structures kya hain? Is chapter ke paanch bunyadi (primitive) computational structures ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Computational structures (hisabi dhanche) computer mein data ko organize aur manage karne ke tareeqe hain, jaise hum contacts, to-do list ya plates tarteeb se rakhte hain. Paanch bunyadi structures: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs.

book_ref.quote: Computational structures help us do that.

blocks.prompt:
2 Define a list. What is an element of a list?
(List ki definition likhein. List ka element kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: List aik data structure hai jo bohat se data ke tukre aik khaas tarteeb mein rakhti hai. Har tukra element kehlata hai aur aik khaas index (maqam number) par hota hai, jis se use hasil karna aur sambhalna aasan hai.

book_ref.quote: facilitating easy access and management

blocks.prompt:
3 How is a list created in Python? Write a statement to create a list of three fruits and print it.
(Python mein list kaise banti hai? Teen phalon ki list banane aur print karne ka statement likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
List square brackets [ ] se banti hai; text items quotes mein likhe jate hain aur comma se alag hote hain.
fruits = ["Apple", "Mango", "Banana"]
print(fruits)
Output: ['Apple', 'Mango', 'Banana']

book_ref.quote: with each item separated by a comma

blocks.prompt:
4 What is a linked list?
(Linked list kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Linked list aik qism ki list hai jo nodes istemal karti hai. Har node mein aik value aur agle node ka reference (hawala) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A type of list known as a linked list uses nodes

blocks.prompt:
5 What is meant by index-based access in a list? Give an example.
(List mein index-based access se kya muraad hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: List ke har item ki aik position hoti hai jise index kehte hain; pehle item ka index 0, doosre ka 1, waghera. Item index se parha jata hai, maslan marks = [45, 67, 89] mein marks[1] se 67 milta hai.

book_ref.quote: You can use these indexes to get specific items from the list.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is meant by heterogeneous elements and duplicates in a list? Give one list showing both.
(List mein heterogeneous elements aur duplicates se kya muraad hai? Aik list likhein jo dono dikhaye.)
blocks.explanation:
Heterogeneous elements: list mein mukhtalif qism ke items aik saath reh sakte hain (numbers, words, balke doosri lists bhi). Duplicates: aik hi item aik se zyada baar aa sakta hai.
Misal: ["Ali", 17, 5.5, "Ali"] mein text aur numbers dono hain aur "Ali" do baar hai.

book_ref.quote: For example, you can have numbers, words, and even other lists all in one list.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is mutability of a list?
(List ki mutability kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mutability (tabdeeli ki salahiyat) ka matlab hai ke list badli ja sakti hai: banne ke baad us ke items update, add ya remove kiye ja sakte hain, maslan items.append("Party Hats") ya items.remove("Snacks").

book_ref.quote: you can update, add, or remove items from the list after you create it

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the output of the following code:
data = [3, "pen", 3]
data.append(True)
print(data)
print(len(data))
(Is code ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Output:
[3, 'pen', 3, True]
4
List dono 3 rakhti hai (duplicates) aur text, numbers aur True aik saath rakhti hai (heterogeneous).

book_ref.quote: This means you can repeat values in the list if needed.

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between insert() and append() for a Python list.
(Python list ke insert() aur append() mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: insert() item ko pasand ki jagah par dalta hai; append() hamesha aakhir mein jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: If you want to add an item to the end of the list, use the

rows: Item ko list mein kisi khaas jagah par dalta hai
Item ko list ke aakhir mein jorta hai
Do cheezein leta hai: position aur item, maslan insert(0, "Invite friends")
Aik cheez leta hai: item, maslan append("Order cake")
Us jagah ke baad wale items aik qadam aage ho jate hain
Pehle se maujood koi item jagah nahin badalta

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between remove() and pop() for a Python list.
(Python list ke remove() aur pop() mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: remove() value se delete karta hai; pop() index se.

book_ref.quote: a. Removing by Value: Use the

rows: Item ko us ki value se hatata hai
Item ko us ke index (position) se hatata hai
Us value ka sirf pehla wajood (first occurrence) hatata hai
Diye gaye index wala item hatata hai; index na ho to aakhri item
Misal: party_list.remove("Buy snacks")
Misal: party_list.pop(0)

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the output of the following code:
jobs = ["Wash", "Iron"]
jobs.insert(0, "Sort")
jobs.extend(["Fold", "Pack"])
print(jobs)
(Is code ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Output: ['Sort', 'Wash', 'Iron', 'Fold', 'Pack']
insert(0, ...) "Sort" ko shuru mein rakhta hai aur extend() do items aakhir mein jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: You can insert an item at different positions in the list.

blocks.prompt:
12 What does the clear() function do? Write the output of:
basket = ["Eggs", "Milk", "Tea"]
basket.clear()
print(basket)
(clear() function kya karta hai? Is ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
clear() list ke saare items hata deta hai aur list khaali reh jati hai.
Output: []

book_ref.quote: c. Removing All Items: Use the

blocks.prompt:
13 How can you check whether an item exists in a list? Write a statement for the list party_list.
(Kaise check karein ke koi item list mein hai ya nahin? party_list ke liye statement likhein.)

book_ref.quote: a. Checking for Existence: Use the

blocks.prompt:
14 What does the index() function return? Write the output of:
colours = ["Red", "Green", "Blue", "Green"]
print(colours.index("Green"))
(index() function kya wapas deta hai? Is ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
index() list mein item ki position batata hai (jahan woh pehli baar mile, 0 se ginti).
Output: 1

book_ref.quote: b. Finding the Index: Use the

blocks.prompt:
15 Write any two applications of lists.
(Lists ke koi do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data storage aur manipulation: records, entries ya values ke majmue rakhna, aasan insertion, deletion aur access ke saath.
2. Sorting aur searching algorithms: bubble sort, selection sort aur binary search aksar lists par chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lists are commonly used to store and manage collections of data

blocks.prompt:
16 How are lists used in matrix operations?
(Matrix operations mein lists kaise istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Numerical aur scientific computing mein lists matrices ko dikhane aur un par kaam karne ke liye istemal hoti hain: har list matrix ki aik row ya column hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Lists can be used to represent and manipulate matrices

blocks.prompt:
17 Write any two properties of a stack.
(Stack ki koi do properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Single access point: items sirf stack ke top se add ya remove hote hain.
2. Size flexibility: stack ka size muqarrar ho sakta hai ya zaroorat ke mutabiq barh sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Single Access Point: You can only add or remove items from the top of the stack.

blocks.prompt:
18 What is meant by order preservation in a stack?
(Stack mein order preservation se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stack mein items jis tarteeb se dale jayen woh tarteeb qaim rehti hai, aur aakhri dala gaya item sab se pehle nikalta hai. Items sirf usi tarteeb mein, top se shuru kar ke, milte hain.

book_ref.quote: with the last item added being the first to leave

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between push and pop operations of a stack.
(Stack ke push aur pop operations mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Push top par jorta hai; pop top se nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two basic operations in a stack:

rows: Stack ke top par item jorta hai
Stack ke top se item nikalta hai
Python list mein append() se hota hai
Python list mein pop() se hota hai
Stack aik item barh jata hai
Stack aik item ghat jata hai; nikla hua item wapas milta hai

blocks.prompt:
20 Write the output of the following code:
trays = []
trays.append("Tray 1")
trays.append("Tray 2")
trays.append("Tray 3")
top = trays.pop()
print("Removed:", top)
print("Left:", trays)
(Is code ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Output:
Removed: Tray 3
Left: ['Tray 1', 'Tray 2']
Tray 3 sab se aakhir mein push hui, is liye sab se pehle pop hui (LIFO).

book_ref.quote: showing how the last book added is the first one taken off

blocks.prompt:
21 Name four uses of stacks in computers.
(Computers mein stacks ke chaar istemal ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Expressions hal karna (infix, postfix, prefix)
2. Function calls ka intezam
3. Parentheses balance karna
4. Undo mechanism

book_ref.quote: are used to evaluate expressions, function call management

blocks.text: 4.1.3.1 Infix, Postfix, and Prefix Notations; Converting an Infix Expression to Postfix

blocks.prompt:
22 What is infix notation? Give an example.
(Infix notation kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Infix notation mein operator operands ke darmiyan hota hai. Yeh hisab aur algebra ka aam tareeqa hai, maslan A + B; tarteeb dikhane ke liye parentheses lag sakte hain, maslan (A + B) x C.

book_ref.quote: This is the standard notation used in most arithmetic and algebraic expressions.

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between postfix and prefix notation.
(Postfix aur prefix notation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Postfix mein operator operands ke baad, prefix mein pehle hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The operator is placed before the operands.

rows: Operator operands ke baad hota hai
Operator operands se pehle hota hai
Ise Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) bhi kehte hain
Ise Polish Notation bhi kehte hain
Misal: A + B ko AB+ likhte hain
Misal: A + B ko +AB likhte hain
Tarteeb ke liye parentheses ki zaroorat nahin
Is mein bhi parentheses ki zaroorat nahin

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is an infix expression converted to postfix? Which data structure helps in the conversion?
(Infix expression ko postfix mein kyun badla jata hai? Is mein kaun sa data structure madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Postfix mein operations ki tarteeb ke liye parentheses ki zaroorat nahin, is liye infix (jaise 3 + 4 * 5) ko postfix (3 4 5 * +) mein badalne se computer ke liye hisab aasan ho jata hai. Conversion mein stack istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: can make calculations easier for computers

blocks.prompt:
25 Convert the infix expression A * B + C to postfix using a stack.
(Infix expression A * B + C ko stack se postfix mein badlein.)
blocks.explanation:
A output mein [A]; * push [*]; B output mein [A, B]; + aaya aur stack par * ki priority zyada hai, is liye * output mein pop [A, B, *] aur + push; C output mein [A, B, *, C]; aakhir mein + pop.
Postfix: A B * C +

book_ref.quote: If you find an operator (like +, -, *), push it onto the stack.

blocks.prompt:
26 During infix to postfix conversion, what is done when a left parenthesis and when a right parenthesis is found?
(Infix se postfix banate waqt left parenthesis aur right parenthesis milne par kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Left parenthesis ( : stack par push hota hai.
Right parenthesis ) : stack se operators output list mein pop hote hain jab tak left parenthesis na mile; phir woh left parenthesis stack se hata diya jata hai magar output mein nahin dala jata.

book_ref.quote: If you find a right parenthesis), pop operators from the stack to the output list

blocks.prompt:
27 Evaluate the postfix expression 5 1 2 + * using a stack. Show the stack.
(Postfix expression 5 1 2 + * ko stack se hal karein. Stack dikhayein.)

book_ref.quote: Start with an empty stack.

blocks.prompt:
28 While evaluating a postfix expression with a stack, what is done when a number is found and when an operator is found?
(Stack se postfix expression hal karte waqt number milne par aur operator milne par kya kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Number: stack par push kiya jata hai.
Operator: zaroorat ke items pop kiye jate hain, operation kiya jata hai aur natija wapas push hota hai. Stack par aakhri bacha item jawab hai.

book_ref.quote: When you find an operator, pop the required number of items from the stack

blocks.prompt:
29 How does a stack help in function call management?
(Function calls ke intezam mein stack kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab function call hota hai to us ki details (kya karna hai aur khatam ho kar kahan wapas jana hai) stack par push hoti hain, taake computer ko yaad rahe ke aage kya karna hai. Function khatam hone par details stack se pop ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: its details (like what it needs to do and where to return

blocks.prompt:
30 Using a stack, check whether the parentheses in (2 + (3 * 4) are balanced.
(Stack ki madad se check karein ke (2 + (3 * 4) ke parentheses balanced hain ya nahin.)
blocks.explanation: ( push: [(]; ( push: [(, (]; ) pop: [(]. Expression khatam hone par aik ( stack par bacha hai. Stack khaali nahin, is liye parentheses balanced nahin.

book_ref.quote: If the stack is not empty, or if you try to pop from an empty stack

blocks.prompt:
31 How is a stack used in the undo mechanism of a text editor?
(Text editor ke undo mechanism mein stack kaise istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har action (text type ya delete karna) stack par push hota hai. Undo dabane par sab se taaza action stack se pop ho kar ulat diya jata hai aur document pichli halat mein aa jata hai. Baar baar undo se pichle actions aik aik kar ke ulat jate hain.

book_ref.quote: the most recent action is removed from the stack and reversed

blocks.prompt:
32 Name two applications that use a stack for undo. Which action is undone first?
(Do applications ke naam likhein jo undo ke liye stack istemal karti hain. Sab se pehle kaun sa action undo hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Notepad aur Microsoft Word. Sab se taaza action sab se pehle undo hota hai (LIFO).

book_ref.quote: Stacks are used to implement undo functionality in applications such as

blocks.prompt:
33 What is a queue? Give a real-life example.
(Queue kya hai? Rozmarra ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Queue aisa data structure hai jis mein pehla dala gaya item pehle nikalta hai (FIFO). Items peeche add aur aage se remove hote hain. Misal: bank ya ticket counter ki qataar, jahan pehla shakhs pehle farigh hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In a computer, a queue works the same way.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write three properties of a queue.
(Queue ki teen properties likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Order preservation: queue items ki tarteeb qaim rakhti hai.
2. FIFO usool: pehla dala gaya item pehle nikalta hai.
3. Dynamic size: items add ya remove hone par barhti ya ghat-ti hai.

book_ref.quote: Below are the key properties of a queue.

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the peek operation of a queue? Give an example.
(Queue ka peek operation kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Peek se queue ka aage wala element nikale baghair dekha jata hai, jaise shelf ki pehli kitab dekhna ke agli kaun si uthegi. Python Queue mein: front = q.queue[0]

book_ref.quote: similar to looking at the first book on the shelf

blocks.prompt:
36 Name the two primary and any two additional operations of a queue.
(Queue ke do bunyadi aur koi do izafi operations ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bunyadi: enqueue (peeche item dalna) aur dequeue (aage se item nikalna).
Izafi: queue khaali hai ya nahin dekhna, aage wala element nikale baghair dekhna (peek), queue ka size maloom karna.

book_ref.quote: determining the size of the queue

blocks.prompt:
37 Write the output of the following code:
from queue import Queue
q = Queue()
q.put("Bilal")
q.put("Sana")
print(q.queue[0])
print(q.get())
q.put("Hamza")
print(list(q.queue))
(Is code ka output likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Output:
Bilal
Bilal
['Sana', 'Hamza']
q.queue[0] Bilal ko dekhta hai (peek), get() Bilal ko aage se nikalta hai aur put() Hamza ko peeche jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: and then serves (removes) the person at the front

blocks.prompt:
38 Name four uses of queues in computers.
(Computers mein queues ke chaar istemal ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Graphs mein Breadth-First Search (BFS)
2. Task scheduling
3. Print spooling
4. Data buffering (maslan online video streaming); call centre systems bhi queues istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Task scheduling, Print Spooling while printing jobs and Call centre systems

blocks.prompt:
39 What is Breadth-First Search (BFS)? Which data structure does it use?
(Breadth-First Search (BFS) kya hai? Yeh kaun sa data structure istemal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: BFS trees ya graphs ko dekhne aur traverse karne ka algorithm hai. Yeh agle level par jane se pehle maujooda level (depth) ke saare nodes dekhti hai. Is mein queue istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: BFS is an algorithm used to explore and traverse data structures like trees or graphs.

blocks.text: 4.1.5.2 How We Traverse a Tree Using BFS?

blocks.prompt:
40 A tree has root A with children B and C; B has one child D. Show the queue after each visit in BFS and write the BFS order.
(Aik tree ka root A hai jis ke bachay B aur C hain; B ka aik bacha D hai. BFS mein har visit ke baad queue dikhayein aur BFS tarteeb likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Shuru: [A]
A visit, B aur C add: [B, C]
B visit, D add: [C, D]
C visit (koi bacha nahin): [D]
D visit: [ ]
BFS tarteeb: A, B, C, D

book_ref.quote: Begin at the root node (1). This node is placed into the queue.

blocks.prompt:
41 In the doctor's clinic example of task scheduling, what do the patients, the waiting list and calling the next patient stand for?
(Task scheduling ki clinic misal mein mareez, intezar ki list aur agle mareez ko bulana kis cheez ki alamat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mareez processing ke muntazir tasks hain, intezar ki list queue hai jo unhein aane ki tarteeb mein rakhti hai, aur agle mareez ko bulana dequeue hai (aage se pehla task nikalna).

book_ref.quote: Tasks as Patients: Imagine that each task your computer needs to do is like a patient

blocks.prompt:
42 What is print spooling? Which data structure does it use?
(Print spooling kya hai? Is mein kaun sa data structure istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Print spooling woh nizam hai jo printer ko bheje gaye print jobs ko aane ki tarteeb mein chalata hai. Is mein queue istemal hoti hai: har document aakhir mein lagta hai aur pehle bheja gaya pehle print hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This process involves the use of a queue to maintain organization and efficiency.

blocks.prompt:
43 How does a queue help in online video streaming?
(Online video streaming mein queue kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Video chhote hisson (chunks) mein buffer hoti hai. Queue dekhe ja rahe hisse se aage ke hisse pehle se jama aur load karti hai, taake internet se data der se aaye tab bhi video bina ruke chale.

book_ref.quote: This buffering queue helps ensure that the video plays smoothly

blocks.prompt:
44 Define a tree data structure. Why is a family tree not stored in a list?
(Tree data structure ki definition likhein. Family tree ko list mein kyun nahin rakha jata?)
blocks.explanation: Tree maloomat ko aik markazi point, root node, se shakhon ki tarah phailata hai; har node doosre nodes se jur sakta hai. Family tree mein parent-child ke pecheeda rishte hain, is liye list jaisi seedhi (linear) shakal munasib nahin.

book_ref.quote: This hierarchical structure is not suitable for storage in a linear format

blocks.prompt:
45 Define root node and leaf node.
(Root node aur leaf node ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Root node: tree ka sab se pehla ya upar wala node, jaise main folder jis mein saare folders aur files hon.
Leaf node: woh node jis ka koi child node na ho, jaise file jis mein koi aur file na ho.

book_ref.quote: The root is the very first or top node in a tree

blocks.prompt:
46 What is the height of a tree?
(Tree ki height kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tree ki height root node se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta hai. Yeh batati hai ke tree kitna gehra ya lamba hai.

book_ref.quote: It tells us how deep or tall the tree is.

blocks.prompt:
47 In the chapter's FamilyTree program, write the statement to add 'Child3' as a child of 'Parent2'. What does the add_child() function do?
(Chapter ke FamilyTree program mein 'Child3' ko 'Parent2' ka bacha banane ka statement likhein. add_child() function kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
family_tree.add_child('Parent2', 'Child3')
add_child() _find_member() se parent node dhoondta hai aur mil jaye to us parent ki children list mein bache ke naam ka naya FamilyMember append karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This implementation shows how to create family members (nodes)

blocks.prompt:
48 What is a balanced tree? Why is it important?
(Balanced tree kya hai? Yeh kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Balanced tree apni height kam se kam rakhta hai: kisi bhi node ke left aur right subtree ki height ka farq aik had (aam taur par 1) se zyada nahin hota. Is se searching, insertion aur deletion O(log n) ke qareeb aur tez rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Balanced trees are essential for efficient operations

blocks.text: 4.1.7.1 Operations on Tree (Insertion, Deletion, Traversal: In-order, Pre-order, Post-order; Searching)

blocks.prompt:
49 Define pre-order traversal. Write the pre-order of a tree with root P, left child Q and right child R.
(Pre-order traversal ki definition likhein. Aik tree jis ka root P, left child Q aur right child R ho, us ka pre-order likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pre-order traversal pehle root node, phir left subtree aur phir right subtree visit karti hai.
Pre-order: P, Q, R

book_ref.quote: Pre-order traversal involves visiting the root node first

blocks.prompt:
50 Differentiate between in-order and post-order traversal.
(In-order aur post-order traversal mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In-order mein root darmiyan mein, post-order mein aakhir mein visit hota hai.

book_ref.quote: then the right subtree, and finally the root node

rows: Left subtree, phir root, phir right subtree
Left subtree, phir right subtree, phir root
Root darmiyan mein visit hota hai
Root aakhir mein visit hota hai
Figure 4.8 ke liye: 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7
Figure 4.8 ke liye: 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1

blocks.prompt:
51 What are insertion and deletion in a tree?
(Tree mein insertion aur deletion kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Insertion: tree mein sahi jagah dhoond kar naya node wahan jorna, us ke parent ke saath (jaise family mein naya fard jorna).
Deletion: tree se aik node hatana is tarah ke baqi tree durust aur jura rahe.

book_ref.quote: Insertion is like finding the right spot in the tree

blocks.text: 4.1.7.2 Types of Trees (Binary Tree, AVL Trees)

blocks.prompt:
52 Define a binary tree with an example.
(Binary tree ki definition misal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Binary tree aisa hierarchical data structure hai jis mein har node ke zyada se zyada do bachay (left aur right child) hote hain. Misal: "Grandparent" root hai jis ke do bachay "Parent1" aur "Parent2" hain, aur har parent ke apne bachay ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: A binary tree is a hierarchical data structure in which each node can have at most two children

blocks.prompt:
53 Differentiate between a binary tree and an AVL tree.
(Binary tree aur AVL tree mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Har AVL tree aik binary tree hai jo khud ko balanced bhi rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: If one side of the tree starts getting too tall compared to the other

rows: Har node ke zyada se zyada do bachay (left aur right)
Aisa binary tree jo khud ko balanced rakhta hai
Usool sirf bachon ki tadaad ka hai
Tree ki height ka khayal se intezam hota hai
Misal: Grandparent, Parent1, Parent2 wala family tree (Figure 4.9)
Aik taraf zyada lambi ho to tree khud ko dobara tarteeb deta hai (Figure 4.10)

blocks.prompt:
54 Which traversals are used for backing up and for deleting a file system? Why?
(File system ka backup banane aur delete karne ke liye kaun si traversals istemal hoti hain? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation:

65 When is a stack the best choice? Give two applications.
(Stack kab behtareen intikhab hai? Do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Stack tab behtareen hai jab data aane ki ulti tarteeb (LIFO) mein process karna ho, maslan backtracking. Istemal: expression evaluation, maze ya DFS jaise backtracking algorithms, text editor mein undo.

blocks.text: 4.3.2 Combining Stack and Graph to perform DFS

blocks.prompt:
71 A tree has root A with children B and C; B has one child D. Write the DFS order using a stack, showing the stack.
(Aik tree ka root A hai jis ke bachay B aur C hain; B ka aik bacha D hai. Stack ke saath DFS tarteeb likhein aur stack dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
A push: [A]
A pop, C aur B push: [C, B]
B pop, D push: [C, D]
D pop: [C]
C pop: [ ]
DFS tarteeb: A, B, D, C

book_ref.quote: It uses a stack data structure to keep track of the vertices or nodes that need to be visited.

blocks.text: 4.3.4 Combining List and Stack to Perform Sequential Operations

blocks.prompt:
72 Write the output of the following code and state why the list is reversed:
marks = [60, 70, 80]
stack = []
for m in marks:
    stack.append(m)
rev = []
for m in marks:
    rev.append(stack.pop())
print(rev)
(Is code ka output likhein aur batayein ke list ulti kyun hui.)
blocks.explanation:
Output: [80, 70, 60]
Har element stack par push ho kar nayi list mein pop hota hai; stack LIFO hai, is liye 80 pehle nikalta hai aur tarteeb ulti ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider a scenario where we need to reverse the order of a list of numbers using a stack.
